question:
Correlation between genome size in polyploid and diploid lineages and life history and occupation of alpine habitat for the genus Veronica (Plantaginaceae) was investigated (Meudt et al., 2015). The genus primarily originated in the northern hemisphere. The phylogenetic tree below includes variables of interest including:

• 1C-value (amount of DNA contained in a haploid genome)
• life history (annual: bar; perennial: no bar)
• habitat (non-alpine: no bar; alpine: bar)
• ploidy (2× to 18×)
question_zh:
研究调查了车前科 Veronica 属多倍体与二倍体谱系的基因组大小、生活史以及是否占据高山生境之间的相关性（Meudt 等，2015）。该属主要起源于北半球。下图的系统发育树包含以下关注变量：

• 1C 值（单倍体基因组所含 DNA 量）
• 生活史（一年生：有横条；多年生：无横条）
• 生境（非高山：无横条；高山：有横条）
• 倍性（2× 至 18×）

images.caption: Phylogenetic tree of Veronica showing 1C-value, life history, alpine habitat and ploidy for each lineage.
images.caption_zh: Veronica 系统发育树，显示各谱系的 1C 值、生活史、高山生境与倍性。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: All the Southern hemisphere species are polyploid.
subQuestions.text_zh: 所有南半球物种都是多倍体。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Polyploidy is always accompanied by genomic upsizing.
subQuestions.text_zh: 多倍化总是伴随基因组增大。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Transitions from annual to perennial life history can be accompanied by migration to the higher elevations or cooler climates.
subQuestions.text_zh: 从一年生向多年生生活史的转变可能伴随向高海拔或更凉爽气候的迁移。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Annual species are never found in alpine habitats.
subQuestions.text_zh: 一年生物种从不出现在高山生境中。

explanation:
A【对】树中标注的南半球物种分支倍性均为 5×–15× 甚至更高，全部为多倍体。
B【错】图中部分高倍性谱系的 1C 值并不比低倍性谱系大，说明多倍化后可能伴随基因组缩减（DNA 丢失），并非总是增大。
C【对】树中多年生分支与高山生境横条、较高海拔/凉爽气候的分布相对应，说明生活史转变可与生境迁移耦合。
D【对】图中一年生横条与高山生境横条在同一分支上互斥，未出现一年生 + 高山的组合。
